newsitem.title: CHINA: China bank in 200 mln yuan telecom loans.
newsitem.headline: China bank in 200 mln yuan telecom loans.

text.p: The Shanghai Pudong Development Bank has decided to extend 200 million yuan in loans for extension of a mobile telephone network in eastern Jiangsu province, the Financial News said on Wednesday.
The bank's Nanjing branch had agreed to lend the amount to meet capital needs of the provincial Post and Telecommunication Bureau to extend an existing mobile phone network, it said.
The extension would be completed by the end of 1996 and the system would be in operation at the start of 1997, it said.
The enlarged network would accommodate 340,000 mobile telephone users compared with the current 200,000, the newspaper said.
